credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: Black metal pastel box made by Winsor & Newton containing a selection of used and broken pastel sticks in various shades of green, pink, brown and white.  The black box has numerous scratches and abrasions on the recto and verso, exposing the silver metal of the box.
